details:
The new feature is great, people have always dreamed of it to have inventory system like in ChilloutVR for example

My suggestions are as to the whole system:

-Create a new SDK like SDK Props or SDK Items and let people create their own props, for example I myself have a pool I made in my avatar, a microphone and a few other things I would love to have on any avatar instead of taking up space in the parameters.

-Permit prop collisions, so as not to abuse this feature, I would add an option in Safety to disable prop collisions.

-All in all, props don't have to be somehow very different from avatars, they can also run on animators plus a few extra components reserved exclusively for them.

-A laser hover and hide option for a given prop, possibly a fallback system, so as not to abuse this system to create crashes, by the way a fallback without logic by its very model can encourage players to unlock a given prop.

-Ranking system as in avatars to set hard limits on how many materials, textures, physbone you can have on a given object, etc.

-The ability to control the animator to allow in station animation changes and control states of animator, this could create portable MMDs or other amazing stuff.

-Video Player support, this could be a dedicated tool to not break into very advanced video players anymore, in fact just being able to paste a link would be great, I would love to add a radio to my pool where I can throw in a playlist and lay around with friends wherever I can. (Of course, video player support also add to safety to get rid of abuse)

-Parameter Tunnel, just like in avatars give the possibility to throw in a couple of parameters, only limit the number of them, 256 is too much for an object, but such 96 or even less I think would be appropriate, here you could also use contacts or even if an avatar has a parameter then just react with it without any contacts, as long as it is on the world, you could then use for example in avatars remote control to change music.

-Audiolink, MIDI, OSC support for the hosting object.

In fact, from my point of view, the props could really be the same as the avatars, just without the movement information transfer and tracking, so I don't really have an idea what else could be added here.

You can also add props in the store so that people can buy one for themselves, but don't block it behind a paywall like, VRChat Plus or the inability of the community to create (no environment and SDK), because I think that could really upset the VRChat community.

I sincerely wish you good luck with the implementation of this system.
title: [FEEDBACK] Some suggestions for items
